exposure: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) exposure in utero
cohort: The study included 198 infants, with 52% having been exposed to gestational diabetes mellitus in utero.
finding: Infants exposed to GDM in utero had higher fat mass, percent body fat, and BMI at birth, but a larger proportion of them experienced less fat accrual over the first year of life compared to unexposed infants.
